    (tenant_id, environment_id, fact_id, subject_id, subject_revision),
entries.replacement: ADD CONSTRAINT record_occurrences_fact_key CHECK (subject_revision IS NULL OR subject_revision > 0),

entries.name: wf3b-scope-kind-by-event-type
entries.claim: The trigger scope tells an engine fact run by its definition's event type, so loadRun re-derives it (E4).
entries.original:
AND c.kind = CASE d.event_type
                    WHEN 'northstar.runtime:event.record-created' THEN 'created'
                    WHEN 'northstar.runtime:event.record-transitioned' THEN 'transitioned'
                    WHEN 'northstar.runtime:event.engine-fact-changed' THEN 'engineFact' END
entries.replacement: AND c.kind = CASE WHEN d.to_state IS NULL THEN 'created' ELSE 'transitioned' END

kills.name: a confirmed booking starts one linked task per company through its owner record
kills.expected: each\ run\ completes\ on\ its\ re\-derived\ trigger\ scope
